The question asks for the feature that medieval guilds and mass production share, as inferred from the passage.

  • D: mass production is tied to efficiency, not an excessive focus on quality.

A general preference for individual creations over mass-produced goods is the older contrast between craft and efficiency, not a stated cause of the recent revival.
